surface.title: The European Slack alternative for an AI world
surface.lede: Your team and its agents in one team. Same channels, threads and DMs you already know — except the assistants in them can draft the note, post it to the right channel and set the follow-up themselves.

draft.title: Agents that draft, not just answer
draft.body: Ask in the thread and the assistant writes the note, checks it against the brief and posts it where the team already works.
draft.first: Can someone summarise yesterday’s launch sync for the exec channel?
draft.second: Drafted a 6-line summary from the meeting notes and the 3 open decisions. Posted to #exec-updates and tagged Jon for the pricing call.
draft.action: Posted to #exec-updates · follow-up set for Thu 10:00

handoffs.title: Same channels. Fewer handoffs.
handoffs.body: Assistants read the thread, pull the context from your tools and set the next step — you only confirm.
handoffs.first: Ticket #4821 is stuck again — customer asked twice about the refund.
handoffs.second: Found the order and the previous two replies. Drafted the refund confirmation, opened a task for finance and moved the ticket to “waiting on us”.
handoffs.action: Draft ready for review · task assigned to @finance

followUps.title: Follow-ups that set themselves
followUps.body: Every decision in a thread becomes a reminder, a task or a DM — without anyone copying it into another tool.
followUps.first: Weekly plan is out. 4 items carried over from last week; owners have been pinged in DMs. Two blockers need a decision by Wednesday.
followUps.second: Move the API deprecation to next sprint, we’re not ready.
followUps.third: Moved. Updated the roadmap doc and told #api-consumers about the new date.
